name: Bucatini
classification_notes: Classified as a geometric sans-serif based on the weight range (Light, Regular, Bold plus a variable version), the absence of italics in any documented release, and the naming reference to bucatini pasta, which suggests a circular or tubular quality in the letterforms. Direct specimen access was unavailable during research; classification is inferred from contextual signals.
summary: A variable-weight geometric sans from Paris-based designer Axel André, named after the hollow pasta.
description: Bucatini is a sans-serif family from Keussel Studio, covering Light, Regular and Bold alongside a variable font spanning the weight range. Designed by Paris-based graphic and type designer Axel André, whose broader work ranges from the rounded medieval display Basteleur to the austere condensed serif Collapse, Bucatini sits as the studio's commercial sans offering. The absence of italics and the tight three-weight static range position it toward display and editorial use rather than long-form text.
foundry_blurb: Keussel Studio offers Bucatini in three static styles and a variable version, available through their fonts.xyz storefront, with individual styles sold separately or as a complete family.
